incidents.name: Dough Finance
incidents.notes: ConnectorDeleverageParaswap: unvalidated flash-loan calldata executed arbitrary calls with user approvals. Source: certik analysis.

sources.ref: Onchain review: ConnectorDeleverageParaswap 0x9f54e8eaa9658316bb8006e03fff1cb191aafbe6 created 2024-06-13T16:22:23Z (block 20084065) by 0x7f7d0fceb73e34933d109598ae2cb1a064280d4b, not the attack-tx sender. keccak(eth_getCode) is identical at the creation and incident blocks, no EIP-1967 or beacon slot is set (storage slot 1 holds doughIndex 0x5390724ca3b0880242c7b1ef08eb9b1abe698c0e, not an implementation), the exploit trace contains no DELEGATECALL out of the victim, and the four DELEGATECALL sites in the runtime are solc external-library calls whose targets are PUSH20 link-time constants (e.g. the DoughCore library at 0x5f2fe377c6fdfcda60befe91c8e0ff4d8142cc77). Deployment basis is exact.
